ablation.name: d4_film_hf1_15ep
ablation.notes: D4: Enable FiLM modulation in SpectralVelocityHead. Currently velocity heads receive NO direct style signal (style_film_heads=False). style_global -> gamma/beta -> z = norm(h)*(1+gamma)+beta. Zero-init for safe identity start. Each subband head gets independent FiLM params -> subband-specific style modulation. Goal: direct style injection at delta prediction point to boost DINO-sty. This is the lowest-cost architectural change (zero structure modification, only enables existing code path).
